  // Loop through each form
  Object.keys(formConfigs).forEach(function(formID) {
    var formSelector = '#' + formID;
    var formName = formConfigs[formID].name;
    var fieldTracking = formConfigs[formID].fields;
    
    var formStarted = false;
    var formAbandoned = false;
    var abandonTimer;
    var lastFieldTouched = '';
    
    // Initialize formInteractionData based on THIS form's fields
    var formInteractionData = {};
    Object.values(fieldTracking).forEach(function(fieldName) {
      formInteractionData[fieldName] = false;
    });
    
    // Get all form inputs
    var form = document.querySelector(formSelector);
    if (!form) return; // Exit if form not found
    
    var formFields = form.querySelectorAll('input[type="text"], input[type="email"], input[type="tel"], textarea, select');
    
    // Track form start
    formFields.forEach(function(field) {
      field.addEventListener('focus', function() {
        if (!formStarted) {
          formStarted = true;
          window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
          
          // Use setTimeout to prevent duplicate fires
          setTimeout(function() {
            window.dataLayer.push({
              'event': 'form_start',
              'formName': formName,
              'formID': formID,
              'pageURL': window.location.href
            });
          }, 100);
        }
          
        // Track last field touched
        lastFieldTouched = field.name || field.id || 'unnamed_field';
        
        // Mark field as interacted
        if (fieldTracking[field.id]) {
          formInteractionData[fieldTracking[field.id]] = true;
        }
      });
      
      // Track when user leaves a field (potential abandonment)
      field.addEventListener('blur', function() {
        clearTimeout(abandonTimer);
        
        // Set 5 second timer for abandonment
        abandonTimer = setTimeout(function() {
          // Check if user left the page or form
          if (formStarted && !formAbandoned && !isUserStillOnForm()) {
            formAbandoned = true;
            
            // Calculate completion percentage
            var completedFields = Object.values(formInteractionData).filter(Boolean).length;
            var totalFields = Object.keys(formInteractionData).length;
            var completionRate = Math.round((completedFields / totalFields) * 100);
            
            window.dataLayer.push({
              'event': 'form_abandonment',
              'formName': formName,
              'formID': formID,
              'lastField': lastFieldTouched,
              'completionRate': completionRate,
              'fieldsCompleted': completedFields,
              'totalFields': totalFields,
              'firstName': formInteractionData.firstName,
              'lastName': formInteractionData.lastName,
              'email': formInteractionData.email,
              'phone': formInteractionData.phone,

              'comments': formInteractionData.comments,
              'pageURL': window.location.href
            });
          }
        }, 5000); // 5 second delay
      });
    });
    
    // Cancel abandonment if form is submitted

      formAbandoned = false;
      clearTimeout(abandonTimer);
      
      // Push form submission event
      window.dataLayer.push({
        'event': 'form_submit',
        'formName': formName,
        'formID': formID,
        'pageURL': window.location.href
      });
    });
    
    // Reset abandonment if user returns to form
    formFields.forEach(function(field) {
      field.addEventListener('focus', function() {
        clearTimeout(abandonTimer);
        formAbandoned = false;
      });
    });
    
    // Helper function to check if user is still on form
    function isUserStillOnForm() {
      var activeElement = document.activeElement;
      return form.contains(activeElement) && 
             (activeElement.tagName === 'INPUT' || 
              activeElement.tagName === 'TEXTAREA' || 
              activeElement.tagName === 'SELECT');
    }
    
    // Track page visibility (user switches tabs/minimizes)
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function() {
      if (document.hidden && formStarted && !formAbandoned) {
        clearTimeout(abandonTimer);
        abandonTimer = setTimeout(function() {
          if (formStarted && !formAbandoned) {
            formAbandoned = true;
            
            var completedFields = Object.values(formInteractionData).filter(Boolean).length;
            var totalFields = Object.keys(formInteractionData).length;

            window.dataLayer.push({
              'event': 'form_abandonment',

              'pageURL': window.location.href

    // Track immediate page exit (before 5 second timer completes)

  function checkVideoCompletion(player, videoId, videoTitle, duration) {
  if (player.completionInterval) {
    clearInterval(player.completionInterval);
  }
  
  player.completionInterval = setInterval(function() {
    if (player.getPlayerState() !== YT.PlayerState.PLAYING) {
      return;
    }
    
    var currentTime = player.getCurrentTime();
    var percentWatched = Math.round((currentTime / duration) * 100);
    
    // Fire engaged at 10 seconds OR 10% (whichever comes first)
    var engagedThreshold = Math.min(10, duration * 0.1);
    if (currentTime >= engagedThreshold && !trackedVideos[videoId + '_engaged']) {
      window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
      window.dataLayer.push({
        'event': 'video_engaged',
        'video_id': videoId,
        'video_title': videoTitle,
        'video_duration': Math.round(duration)
      });
      trackedVideos[videoId + '_engaged'] = true;
    }
    
    // Fire completion at 95%
    if (percentWatched >= 95 && !trackedVideos[videoId + '_completed']) {
      window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
      window.dataLayer.push({
        'event': 'video_completed',
        'video_id': videoId,
        'video_title': videoTitle,
        'video_duration': Math.round(duration),
        'video_percent': percentWatched
      });
      trackedVideos[videoId + '_completed'] = true;
      clearInterval(player.completionInterval);
    }
    
    if (player.getPlayerState() === YT.PlayerState.ENDED) {
      clearInterval(player.completionInterval);
    }
  }, 1000);
}
</script>

<script>

var dataLayer = (typeof(dataLayer) !== "undefined" && dataLayer instanceof Array) ? dataLayer : [];
var videoLabels=[];
var lastP=[];

//we declare variables that will hold information about the video being played
var _playerTitle = {}, _playerAuthor = {}, _playerAuthorURL = {}, _playerUploadDate = {}; 

try{
 init();
}
catch(err){
 dataLayer.push({
 'event': 'gtm.error',
 'errorMessage': err.message,
 'tag': 'Vimeo Video Listener'
 })
}

function init(){
 try{
 var player=document.getElementsByTagName("iframe");
 for (i = 0; i < player.length; ++i) {
 var url=player[i].getAttribute("src");

 if(/player\.vimeo\.com\/video/.test(url)){ // vimeo iframe found
 var playerId;
 
 // Check if iframe already has an id attribute
 if(!player[i].hasAttribute("id")){
   // Generate unique id
   playerId = "vimeo_id_"+i;
   player[i].setAttribute("id", playerId);
 } else {
   playerId = player[i].getAttribute("id");
 }
 
 var urlUpdated=false;
 
 // Check if api parameter exists
 if(!/api=/.test(url)){
   url=updateUrl(url,"api",1);
   urlUpdated=true;
 }

 // Check if player_id exists and update it if needed
 if(/player_id=0/.test(url)){
   // Replace player_id=0 with actual id
   url = url.replace(/player_id=0/, "player_id=" + playerId);
   urlUpdated=true;
 } else if(!/player_id=/.test(url)){
   // Add player_id if it doesn't exist
   url=updateUrl(url,"player_id", playerId);
   urlUpdated=true;
 }
 
 if(urlUpdated){
   player[i].setAttribute("src",url)
 }
 
 videoLabels[playerId]=player[i].getAttribute("src");
 }
 }

 // Listen for messages from the player
 if (window.addEventListener){
 window.addEventListener('message', onMessageReceived, false);
 }
 else {
 window.attachEvent('onmessage', onMessageReceived, false);
 }
 }
 catch(err){
   console.error('Vimeo init error:', err);
 }
}

function updateUrl(url,param,value){
 try{
 return url+((/\?/.test(url)) ? "&" : "?")+param+"="+value; 
 }
 catch(err){
 }
}

// Handle messages received from the player
function onMessageReceived(e) {
 try{
 var data = e.data;
 
 if(typeof data === "string"){
 data = JSON.parse(data);
 }
 
 switch (data.event) {
 case 'ready':
 onReady(data);
 break;
 case 'play':
 onPlay(data);
 break;
 case 'pause':
 onPause(data);
 break;
 case 'timeupdate':
 onPlayProgress(data);
 break;
 }
 }
 catch(err){
   console.error('Message received error:', err);
 }
}

// Helper function for sending a message to the player
function post(action, value) {
 try{
 var data = {
 method: action
 };

 if (value) {
 data.value = value;
 }

 var message = JSON.stringify(data);
 var player = document.getElementsByTagName("iframe");
 var url;
 var prot;

 for (i = 0; i < player.length; ++i) {
 url=player[i].getAttribute("src");

 if(/player\.vimeo\.com\/video/.test(url)){
 // Check if protocol exists
 prot = player[i].getAttribute('src').split('?')[0].split('//')[0];

 // If protocol doesn't exist, then need to append to "url"
 if (!prot){
 url="https:" + player[i].getAttribute("src").split('?')[0];
 }
 player[i].contentWindow.postMessage(data, url);
 }
 }
 }
 catch(err){
   console.error('Post error:', err);
 }
}

function getLabel(id){
 try{
 return videoLabels[id].split('?')[0].split('/').pop();
 }
 catch(err){
   console.error('getLabel error:', err);
 }
}

//our function that will use the Vimeo oEmbed API to retrieve additional information about the video
function getVimeoInfo(url, callback) {
 var script = document.createElement('script');
 script.type = 'text/javascript';
 script.src = url;
 document.getElementsByTagName('body')[0].appendChild(script);
}

//the callback function which takes the data received from the Vimeo oEmbed API and places it into the corresponding objects
function vimeoCallback(e){
 _playerTitle[e['video_id']] = e['title'];
 _playerAuthor[e['video_id']] = e['author_name']
 _playerAuthorURL[e['video_id']] = e['author_url']
 _playerUploadDate[e['video_id']] = e['upload_date']
}

function onReady(data) {
 try{
 //execute our function which queries the Vimeo oEmbed API once the embedded videos are "ready"
 getVimeoInfo("https://www.vimeo.com/api/oembed.json?url=https://vimeo.com/"+getLabel(data.player_id)+"&callback=vimeoCallback", vimeoCallback);

 post('addEventListener', 'play');
 post('addEventListener', 'pause');
 post('addEventListener', 'finish');
 post('addEventListener', 'playProgress');
 }
 catch(err){
   console.error('onReady error:', err);
 }
}

function onPlay(data){
 try{
 var t = data.data.duration - data.data.seconds <= 1.5 ? 1 : (Math.floor(data.data.seconds / data.data.duration * 4) / 4).toFixed(2); 
 dataLayer.push({
 event: "video",
 video_action: "play",
 video_url: 'https://vimeo.com/' + getLabel(data.player_id),
 video_percent: data.data.percent.toFixed(2) * 100,
 video_title: _playerTitle[getLabel(data.player_id)].toLowerCase()
 });
 }
 catch(err){
   console.error('onPlay error:', err);
 }
}

function onPause(data){
 try{
 var t = data.data.duration - data.data.seconds <= 1.5 ? 1 : (Math.floor(data.data.seconds / data.data.duration * 4) / 4).toFixed(2); 
 dataLayer.push({

 });
 }
 catch(err){
   console.error('onPause error:', err);
 }
}

// Track progress: 25%, 50%, 75%, 100%
function onPlayProgress(data) {
 try{
 var t = data.data.duration - data.data.seconds <= 1.5 ? 1 : (Math.floor(data.data.seconds / data.data.duration * 4) / 4).toFixed(2); 
 if (!lastP[data.player_id] || t > lastP[data.player_id]) {

 dataLayer.push({
 event: "video",
 video_action: "progress",
 video_url: 'https://vimeo.com/' + getLabel(data.player_id),
 video_percent: t * 100,
 video_title: _playerTitle[getLabel(data.player_id)].toLowerCase()
 })
 }
 }
 }
 catch(err){
   console.error('onPlayProgress error:', err);
 }
}
</script>

const copyFromWindow = require('copyFromWindow');
const log = require('logToConsole');
const createQueue = require('createQueue');
const copyFromDataLayer = require('copyFromDataLayer');

// Create a GTM-safe Data Layer push queue
const dataLayerPush = createQueue('dataLayer');

// Retrieve HubSpot's `_hsq` object from `window`, or create a new queue if missing
var hubspotLibrary = copyFromWindow('_hsq') || createQueue('_hsq');

var debug = data.debug === true; // Check if debug mode is enabled

if (debug) {
  log('Hubspot Event Tracker Data =', data);
  dataLayerPush({ event: 'HSET - Data', data: data });
}

// Capture input parameters from GTM variables
var email = data.email;
var hubspotutk = data.hubspotutk;
var eventName = data.eventName;
var eventProperties = data.eventProperties || []; // Ensure we have an array
var eventValue = data.eventValue; // Capture event value if present
var eventValueCurrency = data.eventValueCurrency; // Capture event currency if present
var sendEventValue = data.sendEventValue === true; // Ensure checkbox is checked
var eventPropertiesPayload = {};

if (!hubspotutk) {
  data.gtmOnFailure("Hubspot Custom Event Tracker: No Hubspot Cookie Present.");
}

// ✅ Function to safely convert a number to an integer with no decimals
function convertToInteger(value) {
  var convertedValue = value * 1; // Convert to number
  var fixedValue = (convertedValue + "").split(".")[0]; // Remove decimals
  return fixedValue * 1; // Convert back to integer
}

// ✅ Add `value` and `eventValueCurrency` **only if sendEventValue is checked**
if (sendEventValue) {
  if (eventValue) {
    var formattedValue = convertToInteger(eventValue); // Ensure no decimal places
    eventPropertiesPayload.value = formattedValue;

    if (debug) {
      dataLayerPush({ event: 'HSET - Event Value', value: formattedValue });
    }
  }

  if (eventValueCurrency) {
    eventPropertiesPayload.currency = eventValueCurrency;

    if (debug) {
      dataLayerPush({ event: 'HSET - Event Currency', currency: eventValueCurrency });
    }
  }
}


// Identify user (email-based preferred)
if (email) {
  if (debug) {
    dataLayerPush({ event: 'HSET - Identify Email' });
  }
  hubspotLibrary.push(["identify", { email: email }]);
} else {
  if (debug) {
    dataLayerPush({ event: 'HSET - Identify Cookie' });
  }
}

// Log the final payload before sending to HubSpot if debug is enabled
var finalPayload = {
  name: eventName,
  properties: eventPropertiesPayload,
};

if (debug) {
  dataLayerPush({ event: 'HSET - Final Payload', payload: finalPayload });
}

// Push the behavioral event using HubSpot's correct format
if (eventName) {
  if (debug) {
    dataLayerPush({ event: 'HSET - Tracking Event' });
  }
  hubspotLibrary.push(["trackCustomBehavioralEvent", finalPayload]);
} else {
  if (debug) {
    dataLayerPush({ event: 'HSET - Skipping Event' });
  }
}

// If execution reached this point, mark GTM execution as successful
data.gtmOnSuccess("Hubspot Custom Event Tracker: Successful Tag Run");

const createArgumentsQueue = require('createArgumentsQueue');
const createQueue = require('createQueue');

const dlPush = createQueue('dataLayer');
const gtag = createArgumentsQueue('gtag', 'dataLayer');

let fields = [];
const dataObj = {};
const customFields = data.customFields && data.customFields.length ? data.customFields.map(f => f.customFieldName) : [];

// Build a list of fields to fetch
if (data.client_id) fields.push('client_id');
if (data.session_id) fields.push('session_id');
if (data.gclid) fields.push('gclid');
fields = fields.concat(customFields);

// Recursion to get each field in turn and finally push into dataLayer
const gtagGet = () => {
  gtag('get', data.measurementId, fields[0], val => {
    dataObj[fields[0]] = val;
    fields.shift();
    if (fields.length) {
      gtagGet();
    } else {
      dlPush({
        event: 'gtagApiGet',
        gtagApiResult: dataObj
      });
      data.gtmOnSuccess();
    }
  });
};

// Initialize the recursion
if (fields.length) { gtagGet(); }
else { data.gtmOnSuccess(); }
